## Method details

<a id="ApngResourceAnimationReader-method-read"></a>

### read

`ResourceAnimation read(InputStream stream)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The PNG has no IHDR chunk before its image data, the file is damaged: export it again
- `IllegalArgumentException`: The PNG has no acTL chunk or no frame control, it is not an animated PNG: draw it as a still image or export it as an APNG

Reads every frame of the APNG, composed with its blend and disposal, and the play count of the file.

<a id="ApngResourceAnimationReader-method-isAnimated"></a>

### isAnimated

`Boolean isAnimated(byte[] bytes)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns `true` when `bytes` show an animation control chunk before the image data, `false` when they show the image data first or are not a PNG, and `null` when they end before either.
